structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products

law.catch_line: License required; application for license to be in writing; contents

text.section: Every person who operates, conducts, or carries on the business of a commission merchant shall obtain a license.
Application for license shall be made to the Commissioner in writing, signed and sworn to by the applicant.
If requested by the Commissioner, an applicant shall demonstrate his character, responsibility, and good faith in seeking to carry on a commission merchant's business within the Commonwealth.
